[[:File:Dry Top map.jpg|Non-interactive map]] | ingame name=Dry Top | game link type 0=explorable | game link num 0=047 }} [[Dry Top]] is a rather small circular [[map]] [[Location|area]], which connects the rest of the [[Maguuma Jungle]] to [[Tangle Root]]. There are no [[Ally|allies]], no [[boss]]es, nor much of interest in Dry Top; with the exception of what appears to be hillside settlements, as well as a large tree stump in the central clearing. Though most of the land is dry and barren, the sides and bottom of the ravine just west of the center of the map is covered in vegetation as seen in most of the Maguuma Jungle. ==Shrines== ;[[Resurrection shrine]]s *Northwest, near the exit to [[Ettin's Back]]. *Southeast, near the exit to [[Tangle Root]]. ==NPCs== ===Foes=== [[Behemoth]]s *{{w}} 19 (25) [[Root Behemoth]] [[Centaur]]s *{{w}} 16 (25) [[Maguuma Warrior]] *{{mo}} 16 (25) [[Maguuma Protector]] *{{r}} 16 (25) [[Maguuma Hunter]] [[Devourer]]s *{{n}} 17 (25) [[Fevered Devourer]] *{{r}} 17 (25) [[Thorn Devourer]] [[Plant]]s *{{e}} 17 (25) [[Thorn Stalker]] ==Notes== {{gw2w}} *Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 0.5% to the Tyrian [[Cartographer]] title. *{{Vanquisher|count = 55|low = 50|high = 62}} **There are some hidden Devourers scattered around the area. **There is a Centaur group that [[patrol]]s counterclockwise; consider moving clockwise. **Consider holding the [[Zaishen Vanquish]] for this area for three days until the quest to vanquish neighboring [[Ettin's Back]] also comes up. {{Explorable areas in the Maguuma Jungle}} [[de:Trockenkuppe]]
